reason: GauRast is a specific rasterization implementation technique that modifies the standard 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterization process by introducing hardware units, making it a child of the general rasterization method.

The technique describes a specific hardware-algorithm co-design pipeline for Gaussian rasterization (culling, projection, sorting, rasterization), which is a variant/implementation of the Hardware-Accelerated Gaussian Rasterization method.
